bio.text: Doug Ollivant, a retired U.S. Army lieutenant colonel, won the Republican nomination for Virginia's 7th Congressional District in the August 2026 primary and will face Rep. Eugene Vindman in November.
He lives in Culpeper County and is a managing partner at the consulting firm Mantid International.
According to his campaign's announcement, his career includes two combat tours in Iraq, teaching at West Point, and serving as Director for Iraq at the National Security Council.
